Free-credit is a WINBACK (no deposit required, TO kept low). The higher the tier, the better it reactivates (57% → 94%) and the bigger the pack that pays for itself — so size rises with tier. Across all tiers the size sweet spot is RM100–300 (85% reactivation; see the Free-credit reactivation evidence tab). Deposit rows read MATCH % · max-bonus cap — a player gets deposit × match %, capped at the RM figure. +2.4 / RM — best return; big deposits, low % (cap the match)
+0.8 / RM — thin return; keep the pack small

Deposit bonuses pay MORE the higher the depositor's value band (+2.4/RM on whales → +0.8/RM on the low tail), so match % falls and min-deposit rises as the band climbs (big deposits hit the cap). NO-deposit winback (free-credit / free-spins) flips it: most deposits attracted per RM at MID and HIGH (RM1.08 / RM0.91 per RM1), almost nothing on whales (they already deposit) and weak on the low tail — so aim giveaways at mid/high. New players have no prior deposit, so acquisition bands on the FIRST deposit they make. Bigger first deposits stick far better (6% at <RM50 → 68% at RM1500+) — a RM500+ new depositor is worth much more than a <RM50 one even though it costs more to win. Free-spins is the cheapest per new depositor (~RM45) but buys the low-stick tail; a deposit-match welcome that pulls a RM150–500 first deposit is the efficiency sweet spot (~RM90 / FTD, better stick). MY / WS1, matured 30d; directional — confirm with a holdout.

Budget & exposure  ·  bound the TOTAL spend before you launch

Every recommended config above is a PER-HEAD setting. To bound TOTAL spend:  MAX EXPOSURE per code = (players you send it to) × (per-head max-bonus, from the config row).  The figures below are what LIVE codes actually run — use them to sanity-check reach, set a hard max-total cap, and a money stop-loss.

Reach = players who claim per code (median → p90 'busy'). Spend/code = the code's total bonus cost (median → busy). Bigger tiers carry a bigger per-head cap, so exposure scales with tier. Expected NET if it works ≈ spend × the config's Bonus ROI (Retention deposit ~+1.6×, free-spins ~+1.4×); free-credit and VIP are judged on reactivation / loyalty, not net.
Eligible games — where the house keeps the most, and where the segment plays
★ Default — new players + Bronze/Silver + ALL free-spins. Best margin of the high-volume providers + biggest volume.

Highest margin. Small in MY, but a real SG deposit segment (Silver–Platinum 19–26%) — allow it in SG codes.

House margin = GGR ÷ turnover = the cut the house keeps of every ringgit wagered (4.9% ≈ RM4.90 per RM100). Steer eligible games by BOTH the margin AND where the target segment plays by tier: Slots for new / mass players + all free-spins; Live Casino for top-tier deposit + free-credit (even bigger in SG); Sportsbook mainly for SG deposits. Free-spins run only on Slots — 97% on one PP title (Gates of Olympus); test a second Slots title to cut single-title risk.

Total amount bet over the period

What the house won at the table

net NGR in the forward window − the player's own 14-day pre-claim daily-average baseline
Normally RM10/day; after the claim RM30/day → RM20/day above baseline
Estimated change vs baseline (an association, not a proven cause)

Per RM1 of bonus · 0 = no change vs baseline · + above baseline · − below — improvement vs the player's own run-rate, not absolute profit

≥ 1× = the gross margin covers the bonus cost

NGR lift & Bonus ROI use the report's own attribution method — the player's own 14-day pre-claim daily baseline, a forward window that counts later days for less (flat for lifetime), and credit split across any bonuses running at once — reproduced from raw claim rows. It is an ESTIMATED CHANGE vs each player's baseline, not a controlled-test effect and not absolute profit. The per-code tabs show Bonus ROI at 7 / 30 / 60 / 90 days and lifetime — the 7-day figure reproduces the report exactly, longer windows extend it (lifetime rough). Bonus ROI is the only modelled number; the pipeline treats NGR as already net of the bonus. The PAYDAY example is arithmetically consistent with that code's displayed +3.24, but its underlying warehouse lift has not been independently re-run here. Config bands judged on the first-month (28-day) window.
Bonus spent on new players ÷ new depositors
Low % = leaks — most claimers never deposit
PAYDAY 30%: works out to RM212 per player kept
④  Behaviour — do they come back
Of new depositors (matured = had the full window elapsed), share who re-deposited within 7 / 30 days
Of claimers (matured), share who deposited again within the window
Shown with ± points vs the same-type avg
Average of the metric across OTHER codes of the same bonus type (free-credit / spins / reload)
A free-spins code is judged only vs other free-spins codes
Average all-time NGR per player the code brought in
What they're worth over time — a handful of very high-value players pull this average up, so most players are worth less than the figure shown
callsLevers: Works AND pays — brings players back / cheap to acquire, and profitable.
Raise budget, broaden who's eligible. Run it more, to more people. No mechanic change.
Profitable and keeps players, but not standout.
None — keep as-is, re-check next cycle.
Works on ONE axis only — makes money but keeps few, or keeps players but barely profits, or reaches players who'd deposit anyway.
Cut bonus amount, raise min-deposit, tighten targeting. Free-spins: change the game / spin count.
Keeps players but MILDLY too generous to profit.
Cut bonus size a little, raise the betting requirement (TO). A light shrink.
Keeps players but CLEARLY too generous — leaking margin.
Cut bonus %, raise TO, raise min-deposit. A bigger shrink than Trim.
Loses money AND doesn't keep players better than its type (acquisition: brings in nobody).
End it, or replace with a different kind of bonus. Remove from the plan.
How much you give. Cut it for Optimise / Trim / Reduce.
How much they must wager before they can withdraw. Raise it to make an offer less generous.
The entry bar. Raise it to filter to real depositors.
Who gets it. Broaden for Scale, tighten for Optimise.
How much you spend on the code. Raise for Scale, remove for Stop.
Free-credit / free-spins / reload / deposit-match. On Stop, replace with a new build.

Acquisition is judged on cost per new depositor + whether those new depositors come back and deposit again within 30 days; Retention & VIP on Bonus ROI + keeps-players. Same call word, pillar-specific evidence.
A losing VIP code on big players gets Reduce (shrink the offer), NOT Stop — you don't yank a whale's perk.

formulas: ①  The building blocks — counted from the warehouse (facts)
Total amount bet over the period
Bets RM1,000 through the week → turnover RM1,000
Bet RM1,000, won RM900 back → GGR RM100
What the house won at the table
GGR − bonuses & rebates we gave out
GGR RM100 − RM40 bonus → NGR RM60
②  The economics — derived (Bonus ROI is the only model)
net NGR in the forward window − the player's own 14-day pre-claim daily-average baseline
Normally RM10/day; after the claim RM30/day → RM20/day above baseline
Estimated change vs baseline (an association, not a proven cause)
NGR lift vs baseline ÷ bonus spent
PAYDAY 30%: RM653,751 lift ÷ RM202,080 → +3.24 (illustrative; see note)
Per RM1 of bonus · 0 = no change vs baseline · + above baseline · − below — improvement vs the player's own run-rate, not absolute profit
House edge (GGR cover) — does the gross margin cover the bonus cost?
≥ 1× = the gross margin covers the bonus cost

NGR lift & Bonus ROI use the report's own attribution method — the player's own 14-day pre-claim daily baseline, a forward window that counts later days for less (flat for lifetime), and credit split across any bonuses running at once — reproduced from raw claim rows. It is an ESTIMATED CHANGE vs each player's baseline, not a controlled-test effect and not absolute profit. The per-code tabs show Bonus ROI at 7 / 30 / 60 / 90 days and lifetime — the 7-day figure reproduces the report exactly, longer windows extend it (lifetime rough). Bonus ROI is the only modelled number; the pipeline treats NGR as already net of the bonus. The PAYDAY example is arithmetically consistent with that code's displayed +3.24, but its underlying warehouse lift has not been independently re-run here. Config bands judged on the first-month (28-day) window.
Bonus spent on new players ÷ new depositors
Low % = leaks — most claimers never deposit
PAYDAY 30%: works out to RM212 per player kept
④  Behaviour — do they come back
Of new depositors (matured = had the full window elapsed), share who re-deposited within 7 / 30 days
Of claimers (matured), share who deposited again within the window
Shown with ± points vs the same-type avg
Average of the metric across OTHER codes of the same bonus type (free-credit / spins / reload)
A free-spins code is judged only vs other free-spins codes
Average all-time NGR per player the code brought in
What they're worth over time — a handful of very high-value players pull this average up, so most players are worth less than the figure shown
callsLevers: Works AND pays — brings players back / cheap to acquire, and profitable.
Raise budget, broaden who's eligible. Run it more, to more people. No mechanic change.
Profitable and keeps players, but not standout.
None — keep as-is, re-check next cycle.
Works on ONE axis only — makes money but keeps few, or keeps players but barely profits, or reaches players who'd deposit anyway.
Cut bonus amount, raise min-deposit, tighten targeting. Free-spins: change the game / spin count.
Keeps players but MILDLY too generous to profit.

Keeps players but CLEARLY too generous — leaking margin.
Cut bonus %, raise TO, raise min-deposit. A bigger shrink than Trim.
Loses money AND doesn't keep players better than its type (acquisition: brings in nobody).
End it, or replace with a different kind of bonus. Remove from the plan.

How much they must wager before they can withdraw. Raise it to make an offer less generous.
The entry bar. Raise it to filter to real depositors.
Who gets it. Broaden for Scale, tighten for Optimise.

Free-credit / free-spins / reload / deposit-match. On Stop, replace with a new build.
